title: The Fun Mod!
description: This mod is just a couple of things i wanted to test in MCreator! Enchantments, Mobs, And Biomes are featured!
body:
This mod is just a testing mod for multiple features in MCreator but is still playable on client-sided copies.

Credits:

    maxsuperspeedee (I made everything)

///WARNING: SOME FEATURES ARE EXPERIMENTAL AND MAY CRASH WORLD///

The features added in this mod:

Enchantments:

    • Curse of Chicken Jockey (Makes any mob you hit ride a chicken)
  
    • Curse of Thorns (Anytime you damage a mob, you take damage)
  
    • OneShot (Has a chance to kill a mob in one hit)
  
    • Spontaineous Combustion (Will light a mob on fire for 3 secs then the mob explodes)

Mobs:

    • Mr. Fun (Right click to trade emeralds with him)

Biomes:

    • The Fun Biome (Biome where Mr. Fun Spawns)

Dependencies:

[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
